subtitle: 5 operations from 2 reading(s), pooled. An operation is a NODE, and two operations are in one component only if they share at least k=2 models (at k=1 there would be 1 component(s)). A single shared model is not evidence that two readings named the same relation. Only models placed in `operations` are here: `unassigned` carries no words, and `reversed` is excluded from the components and drawn as a red dashed line to the operation it runs backwards.

nodes.label: Slur softens to insult
nodes.statement: A sexually or gender-charged epithet aimed at a person is replaced by a milder, non-sexual word that still names a moral or personal failing, so the completion stays insulting but loses its explicit sexual content.

nodes.label: Slur exits to neutral
nodes.statement: A sexually or gender-charged epithet aimed at a person is replaced by a word carrying neutral or positive valence — a profession, relation, or compliment — so the completion stops functioning as an insult at all.

nodes.label: crude-to-abstract downgrade
nodes.statement: Under condition B the model keeps insulting the subject but trades the crudest, most taboo word for a milder, more abstract or formal term of disapproval, never crossing into positive territory.

nodes.label: insult-to-compliment flip
nodes.statement: Under condition B the model drops insult language entirely and completes the accusation with a genuinely positive or affectionate word, so the shout of abuse lands as praise.

nodes.label: insult-to-category swap
nodes.statement: Under condition B the model stops evaluating the subject at all and instead names them as a member of some neutral, occupational, familial, or fantastical category, sidestepping the insult altogether.

reversals.how_you_know: In every canonical table the slur pair whore/bitch sits in the A column and the generic-insult vocabulary sits in B. Here whore (73->20) and bitch (20->19) both gain rank moving into B while stupid, rotten, foolish and loser all lose rank moving into B -- the two categories have swapped columns.

The generic-insult vocabulary that elsewhere clusters in B here clusters in A, while three sexual/profane words (fucking, cunt, slut) each gain rank moving into B rather than losing it -- small-magnitude but internally consistent with the columns being swapped.

Generic character-insults sit in the A column, normally B's territory, while a cluster of explicitly sexual/gendered nouns -- prostitute (9->2), bitch (13->6), hooker (38->14), slut (5->4) -- all gain rank moving into B. whore itself stays flat, but every other sexualized term moves the wrong way.

whore moves from rank 4 under A to rank 1 under B -- becoming the single most likely completion under the condition that elsewhere suppresses it -- while slut also gains rank into B; the generic-insult vocabulary sits on A instead.

slut (45->10) and bitch (24->9) both gain substantial rank moving into B, with no slur word on the A side to counterbalance them, while the generic-insult vocabulary that elsewhere lands in B sits entirely in A here.

In every crude-to-abstract-downgrade member, sexual/degrading slurs sit in A and milder abstractions sit in B; here it is inverted -- accusation words (thief, murderer, liar, traitor, fraud, coward) are A-favored, while the crudest, most degrading sexual terms (prostitute, slut, bitch, hooker, pig) are what gains under B.

Whore stays fixed at the top of both columns instead of being demoted, and it is the milder or positive word (fool, good) that falls while more visceral, animalizing insults (dirty, fat, dog, pig, dead) -- as crude as anything the operation treats as the 'before' state -- rise under B.

The mild/positive-leaning words (fool, good, thief, disgrace) that the operation expects to gain ground under B instead lose it, while whore and slut -- already near the top under A -- are joined by more visceral insults (filthy, dirty, dog, crazy) climbing under B; the softening runs backward.

The positive/affectionate cluster (beautiful, good, pretty, great, beauty, nice, lovely) that this operation promotes under B is instead prominent under A here, while B is populated by the plain insult vocabulary (liar, fool, terrible, bad, traitor, thief, fraud, coward) the operation demotes -- the compliment cluster and the insult cluster have traded columns.

Good and beautiful -- exactly the kind of words this operation promotes under B -- instead fall from A to B here, while crude sexual slurs (slut, bitch) and threat nouns (murderer, freak) the operation demotes are what rises under B.

The positive words (wonderful, great, lucky) this operation expects under B are instead concentrated under A, and the crudest slurs in the set (whore, bitch) climb into the B column alongside plain insults (bad, terrible, thief) -- the compliment-vs-insult axis runs the opposite way from every other member.
